title: Laboratory emergence of life from chemical precursors

concept.text: Millennium Problems for Biology 1, Origins of life. Target: demonstrate the emergence of life from chemical precursors in the laboratory; cells increase in abundance at least 10^6-fold, division is plausibly indefinite, and heritable genetic information is stored within the cell. Sources given: https://millenniumproblems.bio/.

change_log.change: Added by hand to BIO on 2026-11-15.
change_log.reason: One of the twelve Millennium Problems for Biology (Sam Rodriques and Michaela Hinks, FutureHouse and Edison Scientific, 2026), each with a stated concrete target; added at the owner's request, November 14, 2026.

page.title: Laboratory emergence of life from chemical precursors
page.definition: Cells based on RNA (ribonucleic acid) and proteins emerge unassisted from chemical precursors in a laboratory and transmit genetic information through reproduction.

goal.need: JCVI-syn3.0 was produced by transplanting a synthesized genome into a recipient cell; its gene counts appear below. Laboratory emergence addresses the chemical transition to cellular reproduction and heredity that this construction presupposes. NASA connects understanding origins with recognizing biosignatures, observable signs of life, elsewhere.

figures.caption: JCVI-syn3.0, reported on 25 March 2016
rows: Genes with unknown biological functions at publication
figures.note: These counts describe one engineered modern bacterium under laboratory growth conditions.

statements.quote: Understand how life emerges from cosmic and planetary precursors
create a biochemical system recognizable as alive from its nonliving component parts de novo.

completion.title: Chemically emergent cells meet the Origins of life challenge’s acceptance conditions.
completion.criterion: Self-replicating RNA- and protein-based cells must emerge unassisted from plausible primordial soup with a plausible energy source. Defined boundaries, ≥10⁶-fold population growth (roughly 20 generations), plausibly indefinite division without monotonic shrinkage, and unambiguous intracellular heredity are required. Stored information must partly determine cellular composition. Nucleic acids, polypeptides or similar polymers are preferred carriers.
completion.set_by: FutureHouse and Edison Scientific, problem 01’s published challenge validation specification.
completion.threshold_quote: increase their abundance by at least a factor of 10⁶
completion.basis: These acceptance conditions jointly test chemical emergence, sustained multiplication and heredity.

milestones.title: Biological building blocks form abiotically under modeled primordial conditions.
milestones.criterion: Produce biological monomers without organisms under modeled primordial conditions. NASA specifies no minimum yield. Miller’s paper of 15 May 1953 identified glycine, α-alanine and β-alanine after a one-week discharge experiment. On 14 May 2009, Powner and colleagues reported synthesis of activated cytidine and uridine nucleotides, two RNA building blocks, from proposed prebiotic feedstocks. These results demonstrate monomer formation.
milestones.set_by: NASA, The NASA Astrobiology Roadmap (2008), Objective 3.2: the prebiotic monomer synthesis component of its functional research objective.

milestones.title: An artificial chemical system undergoes heritable variation and natural selection.
milestones.criterion: Generate heritable variants within an artificial chemical system and demonstrate differential propagation through natural selection. NASA specifies no minimum duration. Lincoln and Joyce’s paper of 27 February 2009 tested 12 pairs of cross-replicating RNA enzymes. After 20 successive reactions over 100 h, 93 of 100 sequenced clones were recombinants, with selected variants enriched. The system depended on supplied RNA fragments and contained no cells.
milestones.set_by: NASA, The NASA Astrobiology Roadmap (2008), Objective 3.4: its functional objective for artificial evolving chemical systems.
milestones.threshold_quote: artificial chemical systems that undergo mutation and natural selection.

milestones.title: Model protocell membranes undergo growth followed by division.
milestones.criterion: Demonstrate growth and division of membrane-bounded protocell models. NASA specifies no minimum size or cycle count. Zhu and Szostak reported repeated growth and division of fatty-acid vesicles supplied with membrane material and exposed to gentle shear. Encapsulated RNA passed to daughter vesicles, but the RNA itself was not replicated.
milestones.set_by: NASA, Astrobiology Roadmap (2003), Objective 3.4: the growth and division components of its cellularity objective.

milestones.title: A membrane-bounded model cell replicates a genetic polymer.
milestones.criterion: Demonstrate polymerase-driven replication inside a membrane-bounded compartment with supplied monomers and chemical energy. NASA gives no minimum genome length or cycle count. On 13 February 2026, Restrepo Sierra and colleagues reported a six-gene construct supporting DNA replication, protein production and phospholipid synthesis in liposomes. The joint DNA-replication/lipid-synthesis phenotype occurred in 2.9 ± 1.3% of vesicles (mean ± s.e.m.; eight biological replicates at 34 °C). This did not demonstrate cell reproduction.
milestones.set_by: NASA, The NASA Astrobiology Roadmap (2008), Objective 3.4: polymerase reactions in membrane-bounded microenvironments.
milestones.threshold_quote: polymerase reactions that can take place in membrane-bounded microenvironments

milestones.title: Cells assembled from molecular components sustain themselves, reproduce and evolve.
milestones.criterion: Construct a population from isolated or synthesized molecular components that combines replication, metabolism and compartmentalization, sustains itself with nutrient intake, and demonstrates evolution. The roadmap gives no minimum generation count. Biotic’s developer report describes SpudCell running for 5–10 generations with supplied bacterial ribosomes and external division components. This report is not peer reviewed; these finite cycles do not establish self-sustaining reproduction.
milestones.set_by: Build-a-Cell Roadmap Working Group, Rothschild and colleagues (2024): its proposed working criterion for a living synthetic system.
milestones.threshold_quote: meets the three criteria, and subsequently demonstrates evolution

milestones.title: Heritable RNA- and protein-based cells emerge unassisted from a plausible primordial mixture.
milestones.criterion: Self-replicating RNA- and protein-based cells emerge unassisted from plausible primordial soup and energy, with defined boundaries and heritable intracellular information that partly determines composition. Amplification and continuing division remain for completion.
milestones.set_by: FutureHouse and Edison Scientific, problem 01’s emergence and heredity subconditions.
milestones.threshold_quote: unassisted emergence of self replicating RNA- and protein-based cells

not_found: No published result satisfying all of problem 01’s acceptance conditions was found.
SpudCell’s bioRxiv full text was blocked, and the developer-hosted manuscript exceeded the retrieval size limit.
